title: Determination of the Fermi Energy of Diamond using Photoluminescence Spectral Analysis
summary: Electronic band structures and the Fermi energy provide essential information for understanding the electronic properties of solids. In semiconductors, the Fermi energy is determined by the donor and acceptor concentrations. For diamond, the relationship between the Fermi energy and the donor-acceptor concentrations is highly nonlinear; therefore, experimental determination of the Fermi energy is important.
